title: XamlGen Policy
description: Generator policy file schema. Applied after AST resolution, before XAML serialisation. Built-in defaults live in src/cpmf_uips_xamlgen/policy/default.toml. Caller files are merged over the defaults; unknown keys are rejected.

displayName.description: Controls how DisplayName is set on generated activities.

pattern.description: shortName_hash8: last segment of fullName + underscore + 8-hex-char hash of activityId.

alwaysEmit.description: When true, annotation element is always written even if no content is supplied.
